title: n11 class2-lane cost-69b raw-batch integrity audit - CORRECTION (supersedes class2-lane-cost69b-integrity-repair-20261114.json)
correction: The earlier record class2-lane-cost69b-integrity-repair-20261114.json claimed raw batches B/C/D contained line-wrapped broken JSON rows (bits 32/86/110). This was WRONG: the wraps were an artifact of the web-page text extraction tool used to fetch the raw files (it soft-wraps long lines when extracting text). Fetching the same blobs through the GitHub Contents API shows every stored row intact on a single line, both before and after the 'repair' commit. The 'repair' re-push was byte-equivalent to the original content - no data changed, and no corruption ever existed in the repository. The lesson generalizes: remote integrity checks of pushed JSONL must fetch via the Contents API (or strict per-line JSON.parse over API bytes), never over extracted web text.
